verdict.rationale: Box is a SaaS content platform, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. Box's own docs describe a first-party hosted MCP server at https://mcp.box.com that lets AI agents search and use Box files over OAuth, and a probe confirmed a dedicated remote MCP guide. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connection, and documentation of the specific tool set exposed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Box MCP server is a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at `https://mcp.box.com`. It lets AI agents and apps search and use Box files over OAuth
Give AI agents access to Box content through the Box CLI or the Box MCP server.
